semanticFindings: Both pricing guides faithfully retain complete EN distinctions: Base Google/Meet/views/weather/widgets, Advanced ad removal only, Premium Microsoft/Teams subject to account/workplace limits. No priority-weather paid perk, universal conference generation, free-account blanket, privacy promise or fixed local price introduced.

Subscription purchase, billing Apple Account, provider sign-in, sharing identity and calendar permission remain separate. Cancellation is not unlinking, app deletion or calendar deletion; no all-data-survives or disappears promise. Family Sharing eligibility remains conditional and distinct from shared-calendar access.

Whole-calendar guide preserves all6sections/12paragraphs/6steps/3FAQs: purpose, own versus provider sharing, Reader/Writer/Owner, acceptance with verified-email identity, sample verification and access review. It does not imply everyone must have an individually named email invitation.

Shared with me remains quoted English with an Italian explanation, avoiding an invented localized UI label. Preview/page load is not acceptance. Role depends on identity; Google roles are not equated to app roles.

App-local storage is not automatically Google/iCloud storage. Updates depend on connection/refresh; ICS is separate. Leaving received calendar differs from deleting owned calendar; revocation does not erase prior copies.
Natural task-focused Italian modernization preserves substance rather than summarizing the EN sections. No material language defect found in this bounded own review.
sourcesAndRoutes: Both pricing drafts replace EN Apple cancellation URL with root freshly verified Italian equivalent https://support.apple.com/it-it/118428. Other purchase/Family Sharing URLs retained. Root source read is attributed, not independently re-browsed here.

Sharing retains both exact English-source provider URLs. Existing Italian related routes independently checked against current article-index; unavailable inviting-people-who-do-not-have-the-app omitted.
Pricing related links are existing Italian alternatives rather than missing English-only routes. New sharing route not yet assumed to exist in pricing links.
